tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Opus Lumière (London photographers) services with prices in GBP, deposits, durations and category. Read-only. Booking and secure payment are completed on the website - see booking_url in the result.

tools.name: get_business_hours
tools.description: Opus Lumière session hours by weekday, with timezone (Europe/London) - overall and for each kind of photoshoot (outdoor, studio, at home). Sessions are by appointment - confirm a real slot with check_availability.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live open appointment slots for a service id (from list_services) over an optional date range (default next 5 weeks, max 62 days). Slots are not held - the customer reserves by completing checkout (with payment) at the booking_url.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: The page where a customer completes an Opus Lumière booking, including secure card payment and deposit options. Optionally pass a service_id. Payment can never travel through this API - never ask users for card details.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List Opus Lumière (London photography studio) services with prices in GBP, deposits, durations and category. Read-only. Booking and secure payment are completed on the website - see booking_url in the result." → after: "List Opus Lumière (London photographers) services with prices in GBP, deposits, durations and category. Read-only. Booking and secure payment are completed on the website - see booking_url in the result."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
